cases.summary: Bug: App crash when switching to another tab while items are selected
cases.description:
### Description

The app crashes if you selected a file and switched to another tab while the files are currently selected.

Works fine if you don't select anything before you switch tabs

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open 2 or more tabs
2. Select a file
3. Switch to another tab

### Requirements

- Fix the crash

### Files Version

2.4.51.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22624.1391
